name: Nicholl
source:
(Based very loosely on Fairy Godmother from "Cinderella")

As the son of Charming's previous magic tutor, Nicholl has been living in the castle since he was born. With the sore lack of kids in the palace, Charming and Nicholl have always been the best of friends - and partners in crime for all sorts of crazy adventures.
Now an adult with the important responsibility of teaching Charming magic, as well as acting as advisor to the King and Queen, Nicholl has become more mature and serious. however, the spark of mischief in his eyes and the playfulness behind his warm smile never fully goes away, which he blames on Charming's bad influence and the fairy blood running through his veins. Although Nicholl's favorite past-time is teasing Charming, it's undeniable that he's extremely loyal to her and would go to great lengths to secure her happiness.
